Name: Tapir replace pig
Author: LLususNaturae
Description:
Now with a Content Patcher version!

Download the mod, go to C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Animals, take out both the BabyPig.XNB and Pig.XNB files and store them in another folder (or somewhere you won't lose them. Unzip the mod and move both XNB files into the "Animals" folder. This is my first mod so hopefully it works, let me know if there are any issues

The contents of this mod are free to edit by everyone, so if you want to, for example, make pink tapirs, you can download the tapir sprites and edit them as you please. However please remember to credit me to hopefully avoid any and all future confusion!
